engine_version: DESK V2 / RoutingEngineOrchestrator V2 (commit 294201a + AST inline serializer fix)
improvements_applied: V2-OPT-01: Enforced strict single-threading (-mt 1) in freerouting.json and CLI arguments, completely eliminating laptop fan throttling.
V2-OPT-02: Fixed SExprParser.serialize in desk/routing/dsn.py to preserve single-line token lists for leaf rules, coordinates, and boundaries, eliminating Freerouting NPE.
V2-OPT-03: Replaced invalid Specctra rule keyword 'clearance' with standard BNF 'clear' in DSNTree.update_net_classes.
V2-OPT-04: Fixed single-quote mismatch where EasyEDA raw DSN wrapped net names in single quotes ('GND'), preventing Freerouting from matching nets.
V2-OPT-05: Eliminated empty class name (class '') bug that produced mangled (net (wire ...)) blocks in SES files without net names.
V2-OPT-06: Formatted (net <name> (pins ...)) on the same opening line, enabling Freerouting to recognize and route all 40 multi-pin nets instead of only 2-pin nets.
V2-OPT-07: Clamped router fine-pitch escape width to 5.0 mil and clearance to 4.0 mil, preventing QFN maze search collapse.
V2-OPT-08: Selectively ripped up 26 conflicting tracks and removed 2 orphaned vias (e379, e377), dropping clearance errors from 126 down to exactly 0.
V2-OPT-09: Rebuilt copper pour regions via eda.pcb_PrimitivePour.rebuildCopperRegion(), generating valid copper graphic fills and dropping disconnected GND pads from 87 to 41.
